## 6.0 QR Check-in Failure Handler

Set as the **Error Workflow** (Workflow Settings) on every QR check-in workflow: 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0 and 5.0. n8n runs it automatically when any of them fails, and it emails ALERT_TO with the workflow name, the failing node, the message and a link to the execution.

**Config:** N8N_BASE_URL (your n8n address, used to build the execution link), ALERT_TO, ALERT_FROM, SUBJECT_PREFIX. Select your SMTP credential on Send Alert Email.

**It fires on production runs only, never on manual ones.** Running a workflow by hand and watching it fail will not reach this handler. That is n8n behaviour, not a wiring fault. To prove the email path, run THIS workflow by hand from Test Alert By Hand: it sends a clearly labelled test email.

**It does not diagnose.** The error payload carries metadata only. The execution link is there instead.

**Keep the leading numbers in the workflow names** (1.0, 2.0 ...). Build Alert uses them to explain what the failure means.
